q18938.en: With the sign shown, placed on a two-way road with only two lanes, you must drive as close as possible to the right edge.

explain.short: A bend to the right hides the oncoming cars. Staying close to the right edge keeps you away from them.
explain.rule: On a two-way road with only two lanes, in bends you must drive as close as possible to the right edge (margine destro), so you do not meet oncoming cars in the middle.
explain.trap: 'margine destro' means 'right edge' of the road, not the centre line.

sceneParams.caption: Bend ahead: keep close to the right edge

q18939.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where you must adjust your speed to the visibility and to the radius of the bend.

explain.short: A bend limits how far you can see. You choose a speed that lets you stop within what you see and stay on the road in the curve.
explain.rule: Before and in bends, slow down: fit your speed to what you can see, how tight the bend is, a wet road and your load, so you can always stop in time.
explain.trap: 'raggio della curva' means 'radius of the bend': a tight bend needs a lower speed.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down to fit visibility and bend

q18940.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where you must take the bend with more care if the road is wet.

explain.short: On a wet road tyres grip less. In a bend the car can slide out, so you need extra care and lower speed.
explain.rule: Before and in bends, slow down: fit your speed to what you can see, how tight the bend is, a wet road and your load, so you can always stop in time.
explain.trap: 'bagnata' means 'wet': less grip, so more care, not less.

sceneParams.caption: Wet road in a bend: extra care

q18941.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where overtaking is not allowed if the carriageway is two-way with only two lanes.

explain.short: In a bend you cannot see oncoming cars. On a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking would put you in their lane.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' means 'is not allowed': here that is correct.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking in this bend

q18942.en: With the sign shown you must travel at a particularly moderate speed if you are driving on a space-saver spare wheel (ruotino).

explain.short: A space-saver wheel is thin and grips less. In a bend it needs a very gentle speed.
explain.rule: A space-saver spare wheel (ruotino) is allowed, but you must drive slowly and carefully with it, especially in bends.
explain.trap: 'ruotino' is the small temporary spare wheel: it is allowed, but only slowly.

sceneParams.caption: Small spare wheel: go extra slowly

q18943.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of two-lane, two-way road where you may overtake motorcycles, without crossing the solid white line.

explain.short: In a blind bend on a two-lane, two-way road no overtaking is allowed. Motorcycles are vehicles too, so the ban covers them.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.
explain.trap: 'consentito sorpassare i motocicli' sounds harmless, but there is no motorcycle exception in a bend.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking in the bend, motorbikes too

q18944.en: With the sign shown you must drive as close as possible to the white line that separates the directions of travel.

explain.short: The centre line is where you would meet oncoming cars. In a bend you keep to the right edge instead.
explain.rule: On a two-way road with only two lanes, in bends you must drive as close as possible to the right edge (margine destro), so you do not meet oncoming cars in the middle.
explain.trap: 'striscia bianca che separa i sensi di marcia' is the centre line: the opposite of the right edge.

sceneParams.caption: Keep right, not near the centre line

q18945.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where stopping is allowed but parking is not.

explain.short: In a bend both stopping and parking are forbidden. A stopped car there cannot be seen in time.
explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'fermata' (a short stop) is also forbidden in a bend, not only 'sosta' (parking).

sceneParams.caption: No stopping and no parking in the bend

q18946.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where you may overtake motorcycles, even by going into the opposite lane.

explain.short: Going into the opposite lane in a blind bend is very dangerous. Overtaking is banned there, motorcycles included.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.
explain.trap: 'anche invadendo la corsia opposta' means 'even entering the opposite lane': the worst thing to do in a bend.

sceneParams.caption: Never into the opposite lane in a bend

q18947.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where you may make a U-turn.

explain.short: A U-turn in a bend blocks the road where others cannot see you. It is forbidden near and in bends.
explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' means 'U-turn': forbidden in bends.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turn in or near a bend

q18948.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where you may reverse.

explain.short: Reversing in a bend is dangerous: cars coming round it cannot see you. It is forbidden.
explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'retromarcia' means 'reversing': forbidden in bends.

sceneParams.caption: No reversing in a bend

q18949.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where you may overtake motorcycles, even by crossing the solid white line a little.

explain.short: A solid white line must never be crossed, not even a little. And in a blind bend overtaking is banned anyway.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.
explain.trap: 'di poco' means 'a little': a solid line cannot be crossed at all.

sceneParams.caption: Solid line: never cross it, not even a bit

q18950.en: The picture shows a danger sign.

explain.short: A white triangle with a red border, point up, is the shape of every danger sign.
explain.rule: Danger signs are triangles with a red border and the point up. Obligation (blue circle) and prohibition (red circle) signs are 'prescription' signs, a different family.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' means 'danger': the triangle shape tells you this.

sceneParams.caption: Red triangle = danger sign

q18951.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous bend to the left.

explain.short: The black line in the triangle bends to the left: a dangerous left-hand bend is coming.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: Look at the drawing: it bends to the left ('sinistra'), not to the right.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous bend to the left ahead

q18952.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is not straight, which limits visibility.

explain.short: A bend is a non-straight stretch, and in a bend you cannot see far ahead.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: 'non rettilineo' means 'not straight': that is exactly a bend.

sceneParams.caption: A bend: not straight, you see less

q18953.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that bends to the left with limited visibility.

explain.short: The sign shows a left-hand bend, and a dangerous bend hides what comes next.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: 'curva a sinistra' matches the picture: the line bends to the left.

sceneParams.caption: Left bend with limited visibility

q18954.en: The sign shown warns, as a rule 150 metres ahead, of a dangerous bend.

explain.short: Outside towns danger signs are normally placed about 150 m before the danger. Here the danger is a bend.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: 'di norma' means 'as a rule': 150 m is the normal distance, not always exact.

sceneParams.caption: Usually 150 m before the bend

q18955.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is dangerous because of reduced visibility.

explain.short: A bend hides the road beyond it. That reduced visibility is what makes it dangerous.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: 'ridotta visibilità' means 'reduced visibility': true for a dangerous bend.

sceneParams.caption: Bend = reduced visibility

q18956.en: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed so you can stop if there is a sudden obstacle.

explain.short: You cannot see what is round the bend. Your speed must let you stop if something is there.
explain.rule: Before and in bends, slow down: fit your speed to what you can see, how tight the bend is, a wet road and your load, so you can always stop in time.
explain.trap: 'moderare' means 'reduce, keep moderate': every danger sign asks this.

sceneParams.caption: Slow enough to stop for a hidden obstacle

q18957.en: The picture shows an obligation sign.

explain.short: Obligation signs are blue circles. This is a red-bordered triangle, so it is a danger sign.
explain.rule: Danger signs are triangles with a red border and the point up. Obligation (blue circle) and prohibition (red circle) signs are 'prescription' signs, a different family.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' means 'obligation': wrong shape and colour for this sign.

sceneParams.caption: A danger sign, not an obligation sign

q18958.en: The sign shown warns of an obstacle to pass on the left.

explain.short: The sign shows a bend in the road, not an obstacle. 'Pass on the left' is a blue round obligation sign.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: 'ostacolo da aggirare' means 'obstacle to go around': not what this triangle shows.

sceneParams.caption: It is a bend, not an obstacle

q18959.en: The picture shows a no-left-turn sign.

explain.short: A no-left-turn sign is a red circle with a crossed arrow. This triangle only warns of a bend.
explain.rule: Danger signs are triangles with a red border and the point up. Obligation (blue circle) and prohibition (red circle) signs are 'prescription' signs, a different family.
explain.trap: 'divieto di svolta' means 'turn ban': a prohibition, not a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Warning of a bend, not a turn ban

q18960.en: The sign shown imposes the obligation to keep left.

explain.short: A danger sign gives no order about which side to use. Keep-left is a blue round sign; here you keep right.
explain.rule: Danger signs are triangles with a red border and the point up. Obligation (blue circle) and prohibition (red circle) signs are 'prescription' signs, a different family.
explain.trap: 'impone l'obbligo' means 'imposes an obligation': danger signs only warn.

sceneParams.caption: It warns of a bend; you still keep right

q18961.en: The sign shown requires you to drive as close as possible to the centre of the road.

explain.short: In a bend the centre is where you meet oncoming cars. You must keep close to the right edge.
explain.rule: On a two-way road with only two lanes, in bends you must drive as close as possible to the right edge (margine destro), so you do not meet oncoming cars in the middle.
explain.trap: 'centro della strada' means 'middle of the road': the opposite of the rule.

sceneParams.caption: Keep right in the bend, not in the centre

q18962.en: The sign shown indicates a roundabout.

explain.short: A roundabout sign shows arrows going round in a circle. This sign shows a single bend.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: 'circolazione rotatoria' means 'roundabout': a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: One bend, not a roundabout

q18963.en: The picture shows a prescription (regulatory) sign.

explain.short: Prescription signs are the round ones that order or forbid. This triangle is a danger sign.
explain.rule: Danger signs are triangles with a red border and the point up. Obligation (blue circle) and prohibition (red circle) signs are 'prescription' signs, a different family.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' means 'regulatory' (orders and bans): not a warning triangle.

sceneParams.caption: A danger sign, not a regulatory one

q18964.en: The sign shown indicates a diversion for roadworks.

explain.short: Roadwork signs have a yellow background. This white triangle simply warns of a bend.
explain.rule: This red-edged triangle warns of a dangerous bend to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before the bend.
explain.trap: 'deviazione per cantiere' means 'roadworks diversion': a temporary yellow sign.

sceneParams.caption: A permanent bend, not a roadworks diversion

q18965.en: With the sign shown, on a two-way road with only two lanes, you must drive as close as possible to the right edge.

explain.short: In a left bend cars cut towards the middle. Keeping close to the right edge keeps you away from oncoming traffic.
explain.rule: On a two-way road with only two lanes, in bends you must drive as close as possible to the right edge (margine destro), so you do not meet oncoming cars in the middle.
explain.trap: 'margine destro' means 'right edge': stay right even in a left bend.

sceneParams.caption: Left bend: still keep close to the right

q18966.en: With the sign shown you must adjust your speed to the visibility and to the radius of the bend.

explain.short: You can see only part of the bend. Your speed must fit what you see and how tight the curve is.
explain.rule: Before and in bends, slow down: fit your speed to what you can see, how tight the bend is, a wet road and your load, so you can always stop in time.
explain.trap: 'raggio della curva' means 'bend radius': tighter bend, lower speed.

sceneParams.caption: Speed fits visibility and bend

q18967.en: With the sign shown you must take the bend with more care if the road is wet.

explain.short: Water reduces tyre grip, and in a bend the car can skid. So you need more care.
explain.rule: Before and in bends, slow down: fit your speed to what you can see, how tight the bend is, a wet road and your load, so you can always stop in time.
explain.trap: 'bagnata' means 'wet': more care is needed.

sceneParams.caption: Wet bend: more care

q18968.en: With the sign shown, overtaking other vehicles is not allowed on a two-way carriageway with only two lanes.

explain.short: In a blind bend you cannot see oncoming cars. Overtaking would take you into their lane.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' means 'is not allowed': correct here.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking in the bend

q18969.en: With the sign shown you must travel at a particularly moderate speed if you are driving on the "ruotino" (space-saver spare wheel).

explain.short: The space-saver wheel is narrow and grips less. In a bend you must go very gently.
explain.rule: A space-saver spare wheel (ruotino) is allowed, but you must drive slowly and carefully with it, especially in bends.
explain.trap: 'ruotino' is the small temporary spare: allowed, but slowly.

sceneParams.caption: Small spare wheel: go extra slowly

q18970.en: With the sign shown, on a one-way road you must drive as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: The keep-right duty in bends exists to avoid oncoming traffic. On a one-way road nobody comes towards you, so it does not apply.
explain.rule: The duty to keep close to the right edge in bends protects you from oncoming traffic on two-way roads. On a one-way road there is no oncoming traffic, so this duty does not apply.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' means 'one-way': the keep-right rule in bends is for two-way roads.

sceneParams.caption: Keep-right in bends is for two-way roads

q18971.en: With the sign shown stopping is allowed but parking is not.

explain.short: In a bend both stopping and parking are forbidden. A stopped car there is a hidden obstacle.
explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'fermata' (short stop) is forbidden in a bend too, not only 'sosta'.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping and no parking in the bend

q18972.en: With the sign shown, on a two-way road with two lanes, you may overtake motorcycles without going into the opposite lane.

explain.short: In a blind bend on a two-lane, two-way road overtaking is forbidden. There is no exception for motorcycles.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking in the bend, motorbikes too

q18973.en: With the sign shown you may make a U-turn.

explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' means 'U-turn': forbidden in bends.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turn in or near a bend

q18974.en: With the sign shown you may reverse.

explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'retromarcia' means 'reversing': forbidden in bends.

sceneParams.caption: No reversing in a bend

q18975.en: With the sign shown, vehicles on the "ruotino" (space-saver spare wheel) are not allowed through.

explain.short: A danger sign bans nobody. With a space-saver wheel you may pass, but slowly.
explain.rule: A space-saver spare wheel (ruotino) is allowed, but you must drive slowly and carefully with it, especially in bends.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito il transito' means 'no passing through': danger signs never forbid passing.

sceneParams.caption: Space-saver wheel: you may pass, slowly

q18976.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the right.

explain.short: The line in the triangle goes right first, then left: a double bend starting to the right.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the RIGHT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'la prima a destra' means 'the first to the right': read the drawing from the bottom.

sceneParams.caption: Double bend, first to the right

q18977.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is not straight, which limits visibility.

explain.short: A double bend is a non-straight stretch, and the bends hide the road ahead.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the RIGHT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'non rettilineo' means 'not straight': true for bends.

sceneParams.caption: Bends: not straight, you see less

q18978.en: The sign shown can be completed with a panel saying TORNANTI (hairpin bends).

explain.short: Under the double-bend sign a panel with 'TORNANTI' can warn of a series of hairpin bends.
explain.rule: Under a curve sign a panel can add information: TORNANTI (hairpin bends), or a distance. A distance between two arrows = how LONG the bendy stretch is; a distance without arrows = how FAR away the danger starts.
explain.trap: 'può essere integrato' means 'can be completed': a panel may be added.

sceneParams.caption: Can carry a TORNANTI (hairpins) panel

q18979.en: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed so you can stop if there is a sudden obstacle.

explain.trap: 'moderare' means 'reduce': every danger sign asks this.

sceneParams.caption: Slow enough to stop in time

q18980.en: The sign shown can be completed with the panel in the picture.

q18981.en: The picture shows a danger sign.

explain.trap: 'vietato' means 'forbidden': correct here.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking in the bends

q18996.en: On a road with two lanes and two-way traffic, with the sign shown you should pay special attention to vehicles coming the other way.

explain.short: In bends oncoming cars appear suddenly and may cut the corner. Watch out for them.
explain.rule: On a two-way road with only two lanes, in bends you must drive as close as possible to the right edge (margine destro), so you do not meet oncoming cars in the middle.
explain.trap: 'senso opposto' means 'opposite direction': the cars coming towards you.

sceneParams.caption: Watch for oncoming cars in the bends

q18997.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where a U-turn is allowed.

explain.short: A U-turn in bends blocks the road where others cannot see you. It is forbidden.
explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' means 'U-turn': forbidden in bends.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turn in the bends

q18998.en: With the sign shown, placed on a road with two lanes and two-way traffic, overtaking is allowed in daylight hours.

explain.short: Daylight does not let you see round a bend. Overtaking there is forbidden day and night.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.
explain.trap: 'nelle ore diurne' means 'in daytime': the ban has no time limit.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking in bends, day or night

q18999.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where reversing is allowed.

explain.short: Reversing in bends is dangerous: drivers coming round cannot see you. It is forbidden.
explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'retromarcia' means 'reversing': forbidden in bends.

sceneParams.caption: No reversing in the bends

q19000.en: With the sign shown you must keep a moderate speed only in the first bend.

explain.short: The sign warns of TWO bends. You must keep a moderate speed through the whole stretch, not only the first.
explain.rule: Before and in bends, slow down: fit your speed to what you can see, how tight the bend is, a wet road and your load, so you can always stop in time.
explain.trap: 'esclusivamente' means 'only': a trap word, the care lasts for all the bends.

sceneParams.caption: Slow through ALL the bends

q19001.en: With the sign shown you may stop in the bend.

explain.short: Stopping in a bend is forbidden: a car stopped there is a hidden obstacle for others.
explain.rule: In and near a bend you must not stop, park, make a U-turn or reverse: drivers coming round the bend cannot see you in time.
explain.trap: 'fermata' means 'a short stop': forbidden in bends.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping in a bend

q19002.en: With the sign shown you may overtake motorcycles and mopeds on a road with two lanes and two-way traffic.

explain.short: In blind bends on a two-lane two-way road overtaking is forbidden. Motorcycles and mopeds are not an exception.
explain.rule: In bends with poor visibility, on a two-way road with two lanes, overtaking is forbidden: for every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too, day and night.
explain.trap: 'motocicli e ciclomotori' sounds like an exception, but there is none.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking in bends, motorbikes too

q19003.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the left.

explain.short: The line goes left first, then right: a double bend starting to the left.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'la prima a sinistra' means 'the first to the left': read the drawing from the bottom.

sceneParams.caption: Double bend, first to the left

q19004.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is not straight, which limits visibility.

explain.short: A double bend is a non-straight stretch, and the bends hide the road ahead.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'non rettilineo' means 'not straight': true for bends.

sceneParams.caption: Bends: not straight, you see less

q19005.en: The sign shown warns of hairpin bends if completed with the proper panel.

explain.short: With a 'TORNANTI' panel underneath, the double-bend sign announces a series of hairpin bends.
explain.rule: Under a curve sign a panel can add information: TORNANTI (hairpin bends), or a distance. A distance between two arrows = how LONG the bendy stretch is; a distance without arrows = how FAR away the danger starts.
explain.trap: 'se integrato con apposito pannello' means 'if a panel is added': the panel gives the hairpin meaning.

sceneParams.caption: With TORNANTI panel = hairpin bends

q19006.en: The picture shows a danger sign.

explain.short: A white triangle with a red border, point up, is a danger sign.
explain.rule: Danger signs are triangles with a red border and the point up. Obligation (blue circle) and prohibition (red circle) signs are 'prescription' signs, a different family.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' means 'danger': the triangle shape tells you.

sceneParams.caption: Red triangle = danger sign

q19007.en: The sign shown warns, generally 150 m ahead, of a dangerous double bend.

explain.short: Outside towns danger signs normally stand about 150 m before the danger, here a double bend.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'in genere' means 'generally': 150 m is the usual distance.

sceneParams.caption: Usually 150 m before the double bend

q19008.en: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed.

explain.short: Bends ahead hide the road. Every danger sign asks you to slow down.
explain.rule: Before and in bends, slow down: fit your speed to what you can see, how tight the bend is, a wet road and your load, so you can always stop in time.
explain.trap: 'moderare' means 'reduce': required before bends.

sceneParams.caption: Bends ahead: slow down

q19009.en: The sign shown warns of a road joining from the left.

explain.short: A merging road sign shows a side road joining the main line. Here the line simply bends twice.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'confluenza' means 'merging road': a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: A double bend, not a merging road

q19010.en: The sign shown warns of a road narrowing.

explain.short: A narrowing sign shows the road edges coming closer. This one shows a double bend.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'strettoia' means 'narrowing': a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: A double bend, not a narrowing

q19011.en: The sign shown warns of a slippery stretch of carriageway.

explain.short: A slippery road has its own triangle with a skidding car. This one shows a double bend.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'sdrucciolevole' means 'slippery': a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: A double bend, not a slippery road

q19012.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with a series of humps.

explain.short: Humps have their own triangle with bumps. This one shows a double bend.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'dossi' means 'humps': a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: A double bend, not humps

q19013.en: The sign shown warns of a diversion for roadworks in progress.

explain.short: Roadwork signs have a yellow background. This white triangle warns of a permanent double bend.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'lavori in corso' means 'roadworks': a temporary yellow sign.

sceneParams.caption: A double bend, not a roadworks diversion

q19014.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of damaged road.

explain.short: A damaged, uneven road has its own triangle with bumps. This one shows a double bend.
explain.rule: This triangle warns of a dangerous double bend, the first one to the LEFT. Outside towns it stands, as a rule, 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'strada deformata' means 'deformed road': a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: A double bend, not a damaged road
